sections.title: Viktor Borisovich Koretskiy
paragraphs: It is a poster series titled “Boryas Za Mir - Ne Zabıvay” (Don’t Forget While Fighting for Peace) by Viktor Borisovich Koretskiy (1909-1998), who created the most famous Soviet posters. This series of posters on the theme of peace and the struggle for independence was published in Moscow in 1962.

footnotes.text: [Viktor Borisovich Koretskiy]. (1962). Boryas Za Mir – Ne Zabıvay. Albom-Vıystavka, İzdatelstvo "Sovyetskaya Rossiya", Moskva.
